nodes.name: editor-unified-tabcontent-plan.md
nodes.summary: Planning doc for swapping the Code Editor host's bespoke TabContentRenderer over to the shared UnifiedTabContent dispatcher, covering the required directory renderer, registry remap, type decoupling, and a per-tab-type manual verification checklist before the old renderer can be deleted.

nodes.name: offload-on-close-audit.md
nodes.summary: Audit of the unified WorkStation tab pool's close path verifying whether closing a tab actually releases its held resources (search sessions, browser sessions, project drafts, terminal PTYs), concluding the goal is met except for intentionally-retained terminal PTYs.

nodes.name: phase-2-host-hoist-plan.md
nodes.summary: Phase 2 execution plan for collapsing the WorkStation's ViewMode/App/Dock/Tab hierarchy into a single unified tab surface, sequencing host-context hoists for the Project, Browser, Database, and Editor hosts before retiring the dock and app levels.
